display.summary: An Operations panel for the deployment, and the maintenance page moves into the Composer image.
highlights: Options > admin rail > Operations: review and apply deployment repairs, restart or recreate services, read the logs of one or all.
The maintenance page ships in the Composer image (stack schema 3); composer check --fix migrates stacks, previewed first.
PDF viewer: zoom works in the record modal, fullscreen toggles back, pages read correctly in Arabic.
Needs Composer 1.7.0 for the panel's service operations and the page move.
